programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern heads to Mexico's Pacific coast to explore the local cuisine; in Puerto Vallarta, he tries marinated pork, traditional pozole and skewered mojo fish.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern enjoys the bold, tropical flavors of the island country of Curaçao; this former Dutch trading hub's local cuisine is blended and diverse including African stews and Dutch cheese.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew explores India's capital, Delhi, where he samples tandoori chicken, goat kebabs and samosas.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew explores Harlem, a neighborhood with a diverse cross-section of cultures; Andrew highlights its colorful restaurants offering soul food, Caribbean classics and the national dish of Senegal.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern showcases legendary hotspots and diverse culinary treasures in Hollywood, Calif.; he highlights classic steak and martinis, Thai steamed whole fish, Armenian flatbread topped with minced beef, and Persian ice cream.

programs.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programs.desc: Andrew introduces the coastal cuisine of Guayaquil, Ecuador; bright flavors and local ingredients define Guayaquil's gastronomy; Andrew tries everything from red mangrove crab to a plantain dumpling studded with crispy bits of pork.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: An underground donut spot called Donut Diva in Astoria, Queens, is frying up outrageous cake donut creations and baking unique coffee cake; Eggloo in Manhattan builds an edible work of ice cream art, nestled into a warm, puffy, egg waffle cone.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: Hypnotic Donuts in Dallas serves deep-fried treats in the form of huge fritters with developed flavors; Kate Weiser Chocolate offers crazy candy bars and smoky toffee with bacon.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: At the Wandering Goose in Seattle, they push the boundaries with treats like chocolate chip cookies with toffee and crispy chicken skin; Stir Crazy Baked Goods in Fort Worth, Texas, offers up an assortment of cookies, pies, scones and even quiches.

programs.title: Unique Sweets
programs.desc: Three unique sweet spots deliver layers of incredible flavors and textures; Union Fare Bakery in New York City is creating flavors like red velvet and birthday cake; Slab Sandwiches and Pie in Seattle creates pies in unique shapes and flavors.

programs.title: Spring Baking Championship
programs.desc: Host Molly Yeh tasks the remaining bakers with using a few of her farm favorites to make delightful breakfast treats that wake up the judges' palates; the bakers must make a cake that looks like a painting.

programs.title: Spring Baking Championship
programs.desc: The judges surprise the competitors by giving an eliminated baker a second chance; Molly Yeh challenges the bakers to make desserts that feature candy.
